doc_requests.documents: Under MFA AML rules and SandBank policy §6, because the account would be funded and operated by your relative Suzanne-Clémence Dumas, we need: (1) a valid government-issued photo ID for Suzanne-Clémence Dumas (beneficial owner), and (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration. We'll also need a source-of-funds document for Ms. Dumas, since she would be funding the account. Please note that an account can't be held in one person's name for another person's use. Depending on the documents, the account may need to be opened in Ms. Dumas's name, or set up in a way that shows clearly who owns and controls it.
